name: What is a flexible real estate listing agreement?

mainEntity.name: What is a flexible real estate listing agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A flexible real estate listing agreement, often known as an 'open listing' or 'exclusive agency' agreement, provides sellers with more leeway than a standard exclusive right-to-sell contract. It generally allows the seller to find their own buyer without owing a commission to the agent, or to work with multiple agents. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can help you understand the nuances of these agreements and how they might apply to selling your property in areas like Miami-Dade or Broward County, depending on your specific goals and market conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: A flexible listing agreement offers sellers more freedom to sell their property themselves or work with multiple agents without necessarily owing a commission.
